unit.why: A brief self-reported anecdote: R. Zvi says he would have surpassed a seraph, but his mother ate gentile-cooked cabbage while pregnant with him, which held back his soul's rise.

stories.start_quote: אמר על עצמו פעם אחת שהי׳ מגיע
stories.end_quote: שלא הגיע למעלה זו [בס׳ רחמי האב]
stories.summary_en: R. Zvi once said that his great soul would have risen above a seraph, but because his mother, while pregnant with him, craved and ate a little cold cabbage cooked by gentiles, he did not reach that level.

quotes: רק שאמו הצדיקת בימי עיבורה עמו
tags.why: The tzaddik's mother is the subject of the anecdote.

quotes: התאוה תאוה ואכלה מעט כרוב צונן
tags.why: The mother's act during pregnancy explains the outcome.

quotes: התאוה תאוה ואכלה מעט כרוב צונן
tags.why: A craving for food is what leads her to eat it.

quotes: ואכלה מעט כרוב צונן מתביות עכו״ם
tags.why: Eating food cooked by gentiles (bishul akum) is forbidden.
